title: Titan Core: Salvage
tagline: Dismantle hostile machine Titans, salvage modular components, and rebuild your core.
pitch: Awaken as a cyan identity core in a modular salvage mech inside a giant fallen Titan chamber. Read enemy attack telegraphs, strategically blast enemy subsystems, and instantly decide whether to Install, Secure, or Dismantle dropped components.
coreLoop: Dodge telegraphed attacks and shoot enemy subsystems. Destroyed enemies drop intact components for instant tactical choices that alter your mech.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Aim reticle directly at enemy Weapon or Core subsystems. Destroying the Weapon makes the fight safer but destroys weapon drops; preserving it drops high-tier armaments.

mechanics.name: Telegraphed Evasion
mechanics.description: Red-orange floor Cones/Beams telegraph incoming heavy attacks. Dash out of danger zones before the burst.

mechanics.name: 3-Way Salvage Decision
mechanics.description: When a component drops, choose INSTALL (instant weapon/armor upgrade), SECURE (high score bonus for extraction), or DISMANTLE (instant HP restoration).

mechanics.name: Extraction Choice
mechanics.description: After clearing the chamber, choose to EXTRACT with accumulated loot or VENTURE DEEPER for a higher score multiplier.

controls.keyboard: WASD or Arrow Keys to move, Space to dash
controls.mouse: Mouse cursor to aim reticle, Left Click to fire primary weapon

artDirection.shapes: isometric geometric vector shapes, clean glowing linework
artDirection.backgroundFx: pulsing cyber-conduits and ambient drifting scrap embers

difficulty.start: Single heavy mech enemy firing slow telegraphed laser sweeps
difficulty.progression: Enemy attack telegraphs speed up and alternate with missile barrages as subsystems take damage
difficulty.peak: Enraged core meltdown state with rapid multi-directional hazard zones

winLose.win: Defeat the Titan unit and reach the Extraction terminal to secure score

juice.screenShake: Heavy shake when telegraph attacks detonate or enemy subsystems collapse
juice.particles: Cyan jet trails on dash, orange spark bursts on hit, amber scrap fragments on target destruction
juice.hitStop: 60ms frame pause when severing an enemy subsystem
juice.flash: Red screen edge flash on taking damage, bright cyan radial flash when installing new components

scopeNotes: Build only 1 single-screen isometric chamber, 1 modular player mech, 1 multi-subsystem enemy, and the 3-way salvage decision modal. No multiple levels, shops, or complex inventories.
